aws-sdk-s3-account-regional.title: AWS SDK service model, S3 CreateBucket BucketNamespace member (x-amz-bucket-namespace)
aws-sdk-s3-account-regional.quote: Your account regional namespace is a subdivision of the global namespace that only your account can create buckets in. ... Bucket names must follow the format bucket-name-prefix-accountId-region-an (for example, amzn-s3-demo-bucket-111122223333-us-west-2-an).
aws-sdk-s3-account-regional.verified_via: botocore data model shipped with boto3 1.43.106; enum values account-regional | global

aws-sdk-s3-createbucket.title: AWS SDK service model, S3 CreateBucket / BucketNamespace (botocore s3 2006-03-01 service-2.json)
aws-sdk-s3-createbucket.quote: General purpose buckets exist in a global namespace, which means that each bucket name must be unique across all Amazon Web Services accounts in all the Amazon Web Services Regions within a partition.
aws-sdk-s3-createbucket.verified_via: botocore data model shipped with boto3 1.43.106
